an5.245:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā duccarite. Katame pañca? Attā pi attānaṃ upavadati, anuvicca viññū garahanti, pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, saddhammā vuṭṭhāti, asaddhamme patiṭṭhāti. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā duccarite.
an5.245:2.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā sucarite. Katame pañca? Attā pi attānaṃ na upavadati, anuvicca viññū pasaṃsanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, asaddhammā vuṭṭhāti, saddhamme patiṭṭhāti. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā sucarite ti. CCXLVI-CCXLVIII.
